name: Papua New Guinea
about: Dry season (May–Sep) is best for trekking the Kokoda Track and touring the Highlands; wet season (Dec–Mar) brings heavier rain and rougher diving conditions.
overview: The most linguistically diverse country on Earth — spectacular tribal 'sing-sing' festivals, birds of paradise found nowhere else, world-class diving on WWII wrecks and coral reefs, and the historic Kokoda Track.
costOverview: Local food and coffee are cheap — domestic flights are close to mandatory given how little of the country connects by road, and that's where most of the real cost sits.

specialSeasons.text: The Goroka and Mount Hagen shows bring together dozens of Highland tribes in spectacular traditional dress — among the most extraordinary cultural gatherings on Earth.
